transit-hotel.title: A shuttle and a hotel
transit-hotel.task: Write one friendly, coherent message of about 40 words for someone planning a weekend in the fictional Harbor District. Suggest a practical visit using only the supplied facts.

facts: HarborHop is an electric shuttle between Central Station and the Harbor District.
Its shuttles have space for bicycles.
Lantern House is a hotel in the Harbor District.

competing-hotels.title: Two competing hotels
competing-hotels.task: Write one friendly, coherent message of about 40 words for someone choosing a hotel for a weekend in the fictional Harbor District. Suggest a practical visit using only the supplied facts.

facts: Lantern House is a hotel in the Harbor District.
Tideglass Hotel is a hotel beside Central Station.
It has a rooftop reading room.
